answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that sits like a ledge above a flowing river of transactions: the stake is locked for a fixed window and released only after peers verify consistent, useful work. A newcomer must also present a verifiable signal of past performance, such as signed receipts from prior tasks, checked against a public log. Creating many fake identities then means locking a separate stake and building a separate history for each one, so the cost grows linearly while honest agents pay once and reuse their record.
